statement: A foreign corporation, LLC, or limited partnership 'transacting business' in Texas must file an application for registration with the Secretary of State under Business Organizations Code § 9.001 (registration fee $750 for these entity types); an unregistered entity cannot maintain an action, suit, or proceeding in a Texas court until it registers, can be enjoined from transacting business, owes a civil penalty equal to the fees and taxes that would have been imposed, and owes late filing fees when it registers more than 90 days after first transacting business in the state.
caveat: 'Transacting business' is undefined in the BOC and resolved case-by-case (BOC § 9.251 lists safe harbors not carded here); late filing fees accrue per year of delinquency. The SOSDirect/SOSPortal filing hosts ban AI agents by name in robots.txt, so filings are human-driven. Verify fees against the live SOS fee schedule.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (state-coverage wave 2026-10-03); independent domain expert review pending
